blockingFindings.title: Unrelated gate atomicity changes violate the R7 task scope
blockingFindings.issue: The T-2 scope is limited to exposing the parked resume no-discovery summary in shared help, and its implementation note says to update only the first descriptive summary line of the resume flow registry entry. This diff also rewrites gate phase inference, persistence, retry, and artifact checkpoint behavior in src/flow/lib/run-gate.js, plus related tests, which is outside the R7 parked-resume help requirement.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Remove the unrelated gate atomicity implementation and tests from this change set. Keep the R7 change scoped to src/flow/registry.js and the parked resume help coverage needed to verify the rendered help output.
blockingFindings.rationale: This is tied to the mandatory R7 task guardrail that the parked-resume behavior and CLI options must not change and the implementation note requiring only the first resume registry summary line to be updated. Broad gate behavior changes materially exceed that scope and must be separated or reverted before this R7 task can be accepted.
